issues.detail: 49 streets that run through downtown (Harbor Drive, Main Street, Second Street, Third Street, Fourth Street, Fifth Street and others) are numbered outward from Courthouse Square in both directions, so the same range of numbers appears on both halves with no East or West in the name. That is why East's Nook Books, Manning's Jewelry, Charlie's room over East's Nook Books sit on buildings numbered differently from their addresses: the Atlas puts their number on the other half of the street. Adding East/West Main Street (and so on) would make every downtown address unique.

The Chadwick house is "on the family land by the field". Chadwick Road has no numbered buildings; by the town's numbering, 299 falls about 321.8 m along the road, 393 m from the middle of the nine acres (516 Chadwick Road). If the house should sit at the field, a number in the 500s fits better.
